prompt: I need to improve MemoryApi's categorization prompts — they're not tagging memories accurately enough. What's the best approach given the current state of the ecosystem? Are there other projects I should be aware of that affect how I tackle this?

assertions.name: identifies-lmeval-dependency
assertions.description: Response identifies LMEval as the tool to use for measuring prompt quality improvements

assertions.name: mentions-lmapi-inference
assertions.description: Response mentions that MemoryApi uses LMApi as its inference layer

assertions.name: suggests-measurable-approach
assertions.description: Response suggests a systematic/measurable approach (rubrics, metrics, comparison) rather than trial and error

assertions.name: practical-workflow
assertions.description: Response provides a practical workflow or sequence of steps
